      Movers and Shakers

      Cheers to 5 Years! Waypoint Brokers Collective Celebrates Five Years

      July 13, 2026
      Share
      Copy URL
      Email
      Facebook
      X
      Linkedin
        Listen to audio version of this article
        Sponsored by
        0:00 / 0:58
        Instaread

        Waypoint Brokers Collective is proud to celebrate its fifth anniversary, marking a significant milestone in the company’s journey from a small team of four agents to one of Southern Maine’s leading boutique real estate brokerages.
        Founded in 2021, Waypoint Brokers Collective has grown into a brokerage that stands out for its focus on collaboration, sustainability, and its client-first approach. Today, the brokerage supports 18 agents and has facilitated 759 real estate transactions, totaling more than $500 million in sales volume.
        “Founding and being a broker at Waypoint has been a true labor of love. We’re immensely proud of the growth and reputation we’ve built as a company in such a short amount of time. We’re thankful for the close-knit group of warm and capable brokers we get to work with every day.”
        – Ali Malone, Founding Partner & Designated Broker
        Waypoint Brokers Collective extends its heartfelt gratitude to everyone who has supported the company over the past 5 years.
